name: Look: hold to focus, camera ease, mix duck
body: Hold a button: the player stops, the camera eases in, the crowd ambience ducks, and her glow and nearby traces read stronger. Built on the camera director's look-at and the audio buses.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-21 before any code, from Dean's 'Gameplay Direction: Finding Her' doc (searching as the core mechanic, not a platformer).

acceptance_criteria: Holding look eases the camera in and ducks ambience
Her glow is stronger while looking
